Eagle | Multiple roles | NYC (onsite) | Full-time | $150K–$300K + equity | https://www.eagleeng.com

We’re on a mission to radically transform the way we design and construct our built environment.

Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Eagle works with civil, structural, and MEP engineering firms and transforms them with applied AI. Our thesis: 85% of what engineers do is automatable, yet less than 5% has been touched by AI; the largest gap of any profession. By arming designers with frontier technology, our ambition is to enable the most valuable, talent-dense engineering firm in the United States.

We're looking for founding members of technical staff. If you get excited about building from zero, get energized by direct access to users, and want to work in a problem domain that's barely been touched by AI, we'd love to talk.
